verdict.rationale: A virtual mailbox SaaS could plausibly offer autonomous rules such as auto-scan, auto-forward or auto-shred, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only manual, per-item requests made 'with a few taps', plus a one-off scheduled pickup, which is not a recurring background automation. There is no documented rule engine, scheduler or API (the OpenAPI and llms.txt probes both returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
